title: Pure Inzektor
summary: Pure Inzektor armored insect loop and destruction build, equipping and detaching insect armor to trigger endless card advantage. The deck revolves around Inzektor Dragonfly and Centipede equipping Hornet, Ladybug, or Giga-Mantis, continuously sending equips to the graveyard to pop opposing cards, search the deck, and swarm into Insect Link and Xyz bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Inzektor Dragonfly equips an Inzektor monster from your hand or GY once per turn, and Special Summons an Inzektor from your Deck whenever an Equip Card sent to your GY was equipped to it.
Inzektor Centipede equips an Inzektor from your hand or GY once per turn, and searches any Inzektor card from your Deck whenever an equipped card is sent to the GY.
Zektrike Kou-ou sends an Inzektor card from hand or face-up field to the GY to Special Summon or equip an Inzektor from your Deck, or equip an Inzektor Equip Spell directly from your Deck.
Inzektor Hornet equips from hand or GY to a host, and while equipped sends itself to the GY to target and destroy any card on the field.

summary.title: Opening: Dragonfly + Hornet
steps: Normal Summon Inzektor Dragonfly and activate its effect to equip Inzektor Hornet from your hand or GY.
Send the equipped Hornet to the GY to target and destroy 1 card your opponent controls.
Dragonfly triggers because an Equip Card on it was sent to the GY, Special Summoning Inzektor Centipede from your Deck.
Centipede activates to equip Hornet from your GY, then sends Hornet to the GY to destroy another opponent's card.
Centipede triggers to search Inzektor Giga-Mantis or Zektrike Kou-ou from your Deck.
Equip Giga-Mantis from hand to boost ATK to 2400, or link the insects into Inzektor Picofalena.

summary.title: The Insect Armory
points: Inzektor Ladybug equips from hand or GY and sends itself to the GY to increase a monster's Level by up to 2, facilitating Rank 5 and Rank 6 Xyz Summons while triggering Dragonfly and Centipede.
Inzektor Giga-Mantis equips from hand to set the host's original ATK to 2400, and revives an Inzektor monster from the GY when sent to the GY while equipped.
Inzektor Giga-Weevil equips to grant 2600 DEF and revives an Inzektor from the GY if sent to the GY while equipped.
Inzektor Picofalena (Link-2) discards 1 card to equip any Insect from your Deck to a monster you control, and shuffles 3 Insects from GY into the Deck to draw 1 card.

summary.title: Bosses & Removal
points: Inzektor Exa-Beetle (Rank 6) equips a monster from either player's GY on Xyz Summon, and detaches a material to send 1 card from each player's field to the GY.
Inzektor Exa-Stag (Rank 5) detaches a material to target and equip an opponent's monster from their field or GY to itself as an Equip Spell, gaining half its ATK and DEF.
Number 3: Cicada King negates an opponent's monster effect as a Quick Effect, and when its battle position changes, revives an Insect from your hand or GY.
Inzektor Sword - Zektkaliber grants 800 ATK and recovers an Inzektor from your GY to your hand when sent from the field to the GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Galaxy-Eyes and Snake-Eyes hybrid packages are excluded to keep the list purely focused on the classic Inzektor strategy.

main: Inzektor Dragonfly
Equips an Inzektor from the hand or GY; when an equip on it goes to the GY, summons an Inzektor from the Deck.
Inzektor Centipede
Equips an Inzektor from the hand or GY; when an equip on it goes to the GY, searches an Inzektor card.
Inzektor Hornet
Equipped: sends itself to the GY to destroy a card.
Inzektor Ladybug
Equipped: sends itself to the GY to raise a monster's Level.
Inzektor Giga-Mantis
Equips from the hand for 2400 ATK; sent to the GY, revives another Inzektor.
Inzektor Giga-Weevil
Equips from the hand for 2600 DEF; sent to the GY, revives an Inzektor.
Inzektor Giga-Cricket
Equips itself from the GY by banishing an Insect.
Inzektor Ant
Equipped: adds its stats, and takes destruction in place of its holder.
Inzektor Firefly
Level 1 host: looks at the opponent's Set cards when an Inzektor equips to it.
Inzektor Hopper
Equipped: sends itself to the GY to let its holder attack directly.
Inzektor Earwig
Equipped: adds its stats, and 1000 ATK when it leaves for the GY.
Zektrike Kou-ou
Newest support. Sends an Inzektor card to the GY to summon or equip any Inzektor from the Deck, or equip an Inzektor Equip Spell.
Inzektor Sword - Zektkaliber
Equip Spell: +800; leaving the field, returns an Inzektor from the GY to the hand.
Inzektor Crossbow - Zektarrow
Equip Spell: the opponent can't respond to the equipped Inzektor's effects.
Inzektor Orb
Equip Trap that sends itself to negate an effect targeting your Inzektor.
extra: Link-2 for Insects: equips an Insect from the Deck, and recycles three Insects to draw.
Rank 6: equips a monster from either GY and sends a card from each side.
Rank 5 for Insects: steals an opposing monster or one from their GY as an equip.
Generic Insect Rank 3: negates a monster effect on the field and revives an Insect.
